step 24: enable ufw
  firewall: enable ufw, every rule above already in place, with the default policy ufw has (Ubuntu's denies incoming). Admit allows only the TCP ports sshd listens on, and names every other port that answers from off this host as it reads it. It cannot see DROP rules written by hand in /etc/ufw/before.rules, before6.rules or user.rules, nor a way in that is not listening as it reads the host, such as sslh, dropbear or mosh started later: if you rely on either, enable ufw by hand after checking them. Stays reachable: 22/tcp (sshd (pid 812, uid 0) listens on 0.0.0.0:22 and sshd (pid 812, uid 0) listens on [::]:22), sshd's port, which admit keeps allowed; 80/tcp (caddy (pid 900, uid 0) listens on *:80), allowed by `ufw allow 80/tcp`; 443/tcp (caddy (pid 900, uid 0) listens on *:443), allowed by `ufw allow 443`; 443/udp (caddy (pid 900, uid 0) listens on *:443/udp), allowed by `ufw allow 443`.
  run:
    $ ufw --force enable

step 25: write the admission record
step 26: add the operators' keys
